notes:
- New: Claude sessions use your Interfell connections (Akun > MCP), like Notion, monday and Magnific, without signing in again in Claude Code. Your logins stay in Interfell and renew on their own.
- Read-only threads and the Projects coordinator only get tools that read, never tools that change things.
- A ⚡ chip next to the folder and model shows which connections joined the session.
- Workflows, AI node: paste or drop images, files, folders and links. Folders are read in place; links are fetched when the workflow runs.
